## {.intro}

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="46%"}
[AWS Austin Agentic AI Hackathon · Track 1 · Caregivers]{.kicker}

[Care[Relay]{}]{.wordmark}

[Patients get reports written for other doctors. **Upload yours, and understand what it means and what to do next.**]{.tagline}

[[Team names]{.tbd} · Built on Amazon Bedrock, AgentCore and Strands Agents]{.team}
:::

::: {.column width="54%"}
::: {.report-card}
[From the portal · CT Chest · 10/14/2026]{.card-head}

[IMPRESSION:]{.mono-b}
[2\. 9 mm solid noncalcified nodule in the superior segment of the right lower lobe. For a solid nodule greater than 8 mm, Fleischner Society 2017 guidelines suggest considering CT at 3 months, PET/CT, or tissue sampling.]{.jargon}

[Linda, 58: *"Is this cancer? Who do I even call?"*]{.patient-q}
:::

[↓ upload]{.upload .fragment fragment-index=1}

::: {.plain-card .fragment .fade-up fragment-index=2}
[CareRelay · in plain language]{.card-head}

**A small spot on your lung that needs a second look.** Most spots this size are not cancer, but because you used to smoke, doctors recommend another CT in about 3 months.

[Next step: Capital Pulmonary Associates (in network, 6.9 mi) · Thu Nov 5, 8:00 AM · \$50 copay]{.next-step}
:::
:::
::::

::: notes
Open on the patient, not the tech. Linda opens her portal and reads this. It was written for
the doctor who ordered it, and that doctor (urgent care) won't follow up. Click: she uploads it.
Click: what she actually needed to hear, and a concrete next step.
The plain-language text and the appointment are illustrative mock output (synthetic case_001);
swap in real app output once we have it. TODO: team names.
:::

## How the agents work together {.overview}

[Overview]{.kicker}

{{< include _architecture.qmd >}}

::: notes
Click through five steps. Emphasise: (1) parallel specialists, (2) History turns
"abnormal" into "expected" where a known condition explains it, (3) the incidental ledger,
(4) Insurance and Next Steps negotiate, (5) human confirms. Deterministic tools do the math
(ranges, network, cost); the model explains.
:::

**Upload**

Labs, CT report, history and card. Three agents stream in parallel.
:::

::: {.beat .fragment}
**Merge and wait**

Prediabetes is *expected*; the coronary calcium is *incidental*. A dextromethorphan cough syrup is excluded because of her allergy.
:::

::: {.beat .fragment}
**Follow up**

In-network pulmonology, thyroid ultrasound and PCP visit, priced against her deductible, waiting for a human to confirm.

[Conclusion]{.kicker}

[Every finding gets an owner, an explanation and an in-network next step.]{.closing}
